clauses.evidence: [cast]: mana B-1 W-1, enters the battlefield, +EQUIP; 'card on the battlefield: not a creature'

clauses.clause: This Equipment enters with a soul counter on it.
clauses.evidence: [cast]: 'card: ... counters {} -> {'SOUL': 1}'; also when it enters on the opponent's turn. EtBState = `parse` B5c-etb-soul-counter

clauses.clause: Equipped creature gets +1/+1 for each soul counter on this Equipment.
clauses.evidence: the activation variants equip a probe-placed Scythe, which has no soul counter (a debug replay: a Scythe declared on the battlefield at setup has counters {}; equipping a 2/2 attaches it and leaves it 2/2), so the trace shows no P/T change, consistent with the text. Tree = `parse` B5a-equipped-per-soul-counter. Pack K_malefic_scythe_soul_counters_grow.json PASSES on this packet's tree (draft) and the live tree: cast (1 soul counter), equipped Bear 2/2 is 3/3 and dies to 3 damage, after it dies the Scythe has 2 and the re-equipped 4/4 Giant is 6/6 (the count is read live, not frozen at attach).
clauses.issue: IR/engine gap, not reachable in M21: QProp(source, COUNTER_COUNT) sums ALL counter kinds on the Scythe (executor/quantity.py, COUNTER_COUNT branch: sum(counters.values())), not only soul counters. In M21 nothing but the Scythe itself puts counters on it (every other counter-placer targets creatures), so it plays as printed here; a cross-set effect putting a non-soul counter on it would make it stronger than printed.

clauses.clause: Whenever equipped creature dies, put a soul counter on this Equipment.
clauses.evidence: trace: 'your creature (you_bear) dies -> none' with the Scythe unattached (correct: only the equipped creature counts). Tree = `parse` B2b-malefic-scythe. Same pack PASSES: the opponent's unequipped creature dying adds nothing; the equipped Bear dying adds one soul counter (1 -> 2).

ability [3] target slot: 1..1 of [you_bear, you_giant] (only your creatures); cost W-1 (one generic). Pack K_malefic_scythe_soul_counters_grow.json: an opponent's creature is refused as equip target; the debug replay confirms the attach.
